Volkwagen’s ID. Polo GTI Clubsport Concept Sends 362 All-Electric Horsepower to the Front Wheels

📅 20 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (388 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Roadandtrack

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • In a recent development, volkswagen’s EV push in America has skewed practical, for the most part.
  • Polo GTI Clubsport Concept is an all-electric, track-ready, front-wheel drive hot hatch.
  • Industry observers note that the ID.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, volkswagen’s EV push in America has skewed practical, for the most part. The ID.4 was a generic crossover, so close to an electric take on the Tiguan that VW is actually rebranding it as the ID. Tiguan. And the ID. Buzz, whimsical styling aside, is an electric van—a very expensive electric van. But VW has not abandoned its small, fun hatchback roots in Europe, and the German brand is continuing the celebration of the 50th anniversary of its GTI sub-brand with an EV: the ID. Polo GTI Clubsport Concept, which it will debut at the Essen Motorshow later this month.

The ID. Polo GTI Clubsport Concept is an all-electric, track-ready, front-wheel drive hot hatch. VW shoehorned an electric drive system intended for larger RWD vehicles into the sub-compact ID. Polo GTI; that gives the concept outputs of 362 horsepower (up to 389 hp in short bursts) and 406 pound-feet of torque, a massive increase from the 223 hp and 214 lb-ft in the standard model.

Industry observers note that the ID. Polo GTI Clubsport Concept can hit a top speed of 149 mph, and it can accelerate from 0-60 mph in 4.7 seconds—quicker than a Golf GTI but not quite as quick as a gas-powered Golf R—with the launch control engaged.

This VW’s body is heavily modified from the standard model, as well. It features a two-door layout instead of four, flared fenders, and an enormous front splitter, diffuser, and rear wing. VW also stripped out the interior for track work by deleting the rear seat and cargo area. The two front seats are Recaro racing bucket seats with five-point harnesses, and the interior also has an integrated Tornado Red roll bar.

In a recent development, sadly, this is just a concept for now. Volkswagen has not committed to building an ID. Polo GTI Clubsport, and even if the brand did, it would be unlikely to be offered in the American market. VW did reveal a very cool ID. GTI concept back in 2023, which it has claimed will be more fun than the combustion-powered GTIs. And Volkswagen, pointedly, has not ruled out bringing that car to America—though getting the pricing and timing right in the U.S., with an unstable tariff situation and variable EV incentive climate, may prove tricky.

Renault undercuts BYD with a newly introduced EV that costs less than $20,000

📅 20 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (651 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Electrek

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • The upcoming Renault Twingo E-Tech is among the most affordable vehicles, electric or gas-powered, starting at just £14,745 in the UK, or under $20,000.
  • According to recent reports, another affordable, practical EV the US will never see.
  • The retro-looking EV went on sale in Europe earlier this year, starting at under €20,000 ($22,000), before government incentives.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

The upcoming Renault Twingo E-Tech is among the most affordable vehicles, electric or gas-powered, starting at just £14,745 in the UK, or under $20,000.

According to recent reports, another affordable, practical EV the US will never see. Renault’s latest Twingo E-Tech is an electric remake of its iconic 1990s city car.

The retro-looking EV went on sale in Europe earlier this year, starting at under €20,000 ($22,000), before government incentives. In places like Germany, it starts at about €13,990 ($15,500), including the €6,000 ($6,600) federal EV grant.

In the UK, Renault announced that prices for the Twingo E-Tech will start at just £14,745, or about $19,500. That includes the government’s Electric Clean Car Grant (ECG) of £3,750 ($4,900).

At that price, Renault’s newly introduced electric car is among the most affordable vehicles available, including gas-powered cars.

It’s cheaper than the gas-powered Dacia Sandero (£14,765) and BYD’s cheapest EV, the Dolphin Surf (£18,675). Only a few cars are lower-priced, including the Dacia Spring (£11,990) and Leapmotor T03 (£12,995).

What do you get for the price? At just 3,790 mm (149.2″) long, the electric city car is a bit smaller than the Hyundai Inster and the BYD Dolphin Surf.

For those in the US, that’s even smaller than the first-generation Chevy Bolt EV, which measured 4,145 mm (163.2″) in length.

Despite its compact size, the “cheeky, practical” 5-door city car, as Renault calls it, offers up to 360 liters of boot capacity. It also features independent, sliding 50/50 folding rear seats to haul bigger items like a surfboard.

With up to 50 kW DC fast charging, Renault stated the Twingo E-Tech can charge from 15% to 80% in 28 minutes.

The base Renault Twingo E-Tech Evolution, priced from £14,745 ($19,500), uses a 27.5 kWh LFP battery and an 80 hp (60 kW) motor, delivering up to 163 miles of WLTP range.

The entry-level version features 16″ steel wheels, a 7″ driver display, 10″ navigation screen, and ADAS features, including cruise control and lane-keep assist.

It has been revealed that renault will offer three Twingo E-Tech trims in total. The mid-range Techno trim gains 18″ wheels, Google built-in with Renault’s Reno avatar, a reversing camera, automatic climate control, a hands-free key card, One Pedal driving, and heated front seats. It starts at £16,245 ($21,500), including the £3,750 ($4,900) ECG.

With Google built in, drivers can easily find and navigate to charging stations via Google Maps, use Google Gemini AI virtual assistance, or access over 100 apps, including Waze and Amazon Music.

Industry observers note that at least this car has some styling unlike the generic box style VW offerings in this category. In this size car I prefer the SUV style of the Dacia Spring for myself, but of course we will never see any of these wonderful cars in the USA.

The top-spec Twingo E-Tech Launch Edition, priced from £17,645 ($23,200), including the £3,750 ($4,900) ECG, adds a suite of ADAS features, including blind-spot warning, rear cross-traffic alert and hands-free parking.

Inside, the Launch Edition features a special mottled textile upholstery with red stitching and premium floor mats.

Renault is offering a special promo for those who buy a new Twingo E-Tech through Mobilize Financial Services on a PCP or HP agreement by June 30, 2027, which includes two years’ free servicing.

Interested buyers can purchase the Twingo R Pass for £100, giving them priority access to ordering, a mini Twingo E-Tech model, and a green Renault key cover.

#155440. How Italians Cured My Loneliness

How Italians Cured My Loneliness

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (834 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Psychologytoday

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Updated November 23, 2026 | Reviewed by Ekua Hagan.
  • A couple of years ago, I’d made the painful decision to leave my marriage, and my beloved dog of 13 years had died.
  • The life I had always imagined for myself—a long-term stable marriage and a family nested in community—had never materialized.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Updated November 23, 2026 | Reviewed by Ekua Hagan.

A couple of years ago, I’d made the painful decision to leave my marriage, and my beloved dog of 13 years had died. Suddenly, I found myself deeply alone.

The life I had always imagined for myself—a long-term stable marriage and a family nested in community—had never materialized.

One day, though, I realized that there was something that I had dreamed of when I was younger, that suddenly might be possible.

Industry observers note that I went. And I went again. I discovered a lesser-known town in my favorite area, and an affordable apartment that I could use periodically in the off-season. I committed to going, using airline points, when I had lulls between stretches of speaking engagements.

In a recent development, because of my youthful obsession with all things Italian, I had studied the language. I’d also had a long-distance Italian boyfriend for a few months in my early 30s.

I brushed up via a language app, and this was the key that opened all doors.

In Canada, I was a solitary woman who had to book appointments to see her busy friends, all of whom had families.

In Italy, I found myself swept up into a large, generous family and their circle of friends, and rarely had enough time to sit and read a book.

The way I learned to live in Italy transformed the way I live at home.

I always thought my phone aversion was due to being an introvert. Even if the name on my screen was a friend, I’d send it to voicemail and text them a little bit later.

In Italy, I discovered the delight of being interrupted.

At least once a day, my friend Vincenza knocked at my door unannounced, calling out my name. My old Canadian self might have pretended not to be home, but I began to associate these unexpected visits with delight. Vincenza usually had a plate of hot pasta or pastries in her arms, or her sister Angela would call to invite me for lunch.

The effect stuck. Today, when a friend or family member calls me, I find myself answering. Sometimes I even call them.

Part of why I wouldn’t answer the phone when it rang was because it wasn’t part of "the initiative." I ran a tight ship. Or perhaps not actually that tight, because I was usually already behind on the day’s to-do list. There wasn’t room for an unplanned 15-minute chat with a friend.

In Italy, Angela randomly calls to let me know that they’ll gather in the piazza in 10 minutes “because the sun is so beautiful today.”.

An impromptu lunch invitation may stretch into a couple of hours around a table with friends.

When I run into Vincenza’s daughter, Nausica, while out running errands, she often invites me for a spontaneous coffee or aperitivo, or to go to a store around the corner and help her pick out a dress for an event.

In my past life, I believed that because I was doing something (anything) else, the natural answer was, "Sorry, not now.".

I’ve learned that unless I absolutely must be doing something else, the best answer is “Sure, why not?”.

If you’ve seen the meme of the hyper-independent woman carrying a clothes washer up the subway steps by herself, that’s me.

I don’t like needing or asking for help. I am, however, a professional helper. Literally. I’m a medical doctor, an executive coach, and a professional speaker/educator. Perhaps most importantly, I’m also the first-born daughter of four.

I will help you with things you didn’t even know you needed help with.

Then there are my Italian friends. They don’t need my help. They don’t seem to even want my help.

Industry observers note that they stealthily pay for my aperitivo or pizza, sneaking the waiter money while pretending to use the washroom. I once tried to pay for parking, and my friend wrestled me out of the way so intensely that I hesitate to ever attempt it again.

It has been revealed that but what about medical help? Surely, there might be potential for heroics. Nope, they already have a doctor in the family.

In a recent development, the thing is, they seem to just enjoy having me around—without me doing anything other than showing up and eating the food they place in front of me, with great enthusiasm. This seems to be all one needs to do to earn permanently adopted status.

I think that was the ultimate blow that broke the chains of my very North American loneliness. In a “What can you do for me?” world, it’s remarkable to discover a collective of people, all of whom seem to live by the same rules: “You’ll always have a place at my table—just don’t argue when I serve you more pasta.”.

Great horned owl survives 70 miles stuck in a moving truck

📅 20 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (482 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Popsci

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • In a recent development, in March, we reported on a bobcat who endured a four-hour surgery on two broken legs after getting hit and dragged by a car, after her head had gotten stuck in the car’s grill.
  • “This is a very unusual case, as most animals that are hit by a tractor-trailer die due to their injuries or are killed instantly,” Tracie Young, director of Raven Ridge Wildlife Center tells Popular Science.
  • According to recent reports, the wildlife center’s team received a voicemail from cargo and freight company Old Dominion Freight Line, saying that one of their drivers in Pennsylvania had hit an owl.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, in March, we reported on a bobcat who endured a four-hour surgery on two broken legs after getting hit and dragged by a car, after her head had gotten stuck in the car’s grill. During a strangely similar scenario, the same wildlife center in Pennsylvania recently treated a great horned owl (Bubo virginianus) who also got jammed in the front of a vehicle. But this one was dragged along for 70 miles.

“This is a very unusual case, as most animals that are hit by a tractor-trailer die due to their injuries or are killed instantly,” Tracie Young, director of Raven Ridge Wildlife Center tells Popular Science.

According to recent reports, the wildlife center’s team received a voicemail from cargo and freight company Old Dominion Freight Line, saying that one of their drivers in Pennsylvania had hit an owl. When they called back, they discovered that the owl was alive and had gotten stuck in the truck’s air dam. The company’s maintenance team was able to remove the owl, but something was clearly wrong with the bird because it couldn’t fly away.

The wildlife team told them to place the injured animal in a dark and quiet place. Ultimately, transport volunteers were able to transfer the owl to Raven Ridge, where the team had waited to receive the patient past the wildlife center’s closing hours. Its feathers were a mess, but the staff was shocked to find no broken wings or legs, nor open wounds. The owl had just injured its left eye.

Recent findings suggest that but when they called back the next day, “the story got even more incredible,” according to the wildlife center. The driver had felt the collision, but she didn’t know that the owl had gotten stuck on the truck, so she’d continued driving all the way back to the terminal.

“The distance from the spot where the owl was hit to the terminal was 70 miles,” the team wrote.“The owl was stuck headfirst in the fiberglass air dam for 70 miles at 65 miles per hour. It’s truly the luckiest owl we’ve ever seen.”.

In a recent development, staff brought the hardy survivor to their vet for an eye exam, which revealed blood and swelling in the injured eye. The wildlife team is now monitoring the bird’s recovery.

It has been revealed that “The owl is doing great, and the left eye that sustained the damage is also healing. After we move the owl outside into a flight cage, we will make sure that the owl can sustain flight, that there are no obvious underlying complications, and that it can find the food placed in its cage,” Young concludes.

The goal is to ultimately release it close to where the collision occurred.

The 13 Best T-Shirts for Men, According to Style Experts

💡 Key Takeaways
  • It has been revealed that IF YOU’RE BUILDING a better wardrobe, start with your T-shirts.
  • Sources indicate that more mensweat brands are treating them seriously too, with upgraded fabrics, sharper cuts, and construction built to go the distance.
  • At Men's Health, our fashion editors have worn, washed, and wowed in more T-shirts than you can count.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that IF YOU’RE BUILDING a better wardrobe, start with your T-shirts. Pick the right one, and it can make your shoulders look broader, show off your chest, and make your whole outfit sharper. Pick the wrong one, and suddenly even clean jeans can’t save you. That’s why the bar for a good T-shirt should be higher than most guys set it—you want one that works under a hoodie, looks great solo with denim, or even under a blazer if you’re feeling bold.

Sources indicate that more mensweat brands are treating them seriously too, with upgraded fabrics, sharper cuts, and construction built to go the distance. The key is knowing where to invest. If you need something to throw on around the house, an affordable multipack makes sense, but make sure it holds up to swear and repeated washes. But if the tee is going to carry an outfit—or at the gym—it’s worth spending a little extra for something that fits right and will last. We’ve tested tees from every menswear brand on the market to find the best ones for work, workouts, and everywhere in between.

At Men's Health, our fashion editors have worn, washed, and wowed in more T-shirts than you can count. That said, when we vouch for one, believe us. My ultimate favorite is this crew neck version from Mack Weldon, which is made with Supima cotton, aka the softest, strongest, and most durable cotton. It feels like a second skin, breathes well, and the slim fit is flattering. I’m 5'8" and wear a size small, and it hugs my biceps and pecs with just the right amount of tightness while still leaving plenty of breathing room.

I’ve worn this tee during errands, and I found that it's managed to retain its soft touch and original shape after multiple washes. The infused stretch makes this a cinch to move in, whether I was reaching for something in a high cabinet or putting my luggage in the plane's overhead compartment. Plus, every seam is super reinforced so it can handle tons of mileage without a single thread giving in.

Industry observers note that I’m not kidding when I say I’ve worn this just about everywhere. Since it's woven with antimicrobial silver threads that fight odor-causing bacteria, I've used it as a workout shirt for serious sweat sessions and stayed smelling fresh. Performance aside, I’ve made this tee work in a bunch of settings: rocking it with jeans for an everyday look, and even layering it under a blazer when I want to dress things up. Plus, it's available in a variety of colors to choose from.

Read More: Mack Weldon Silver Crew Neck T-Shirt Review.

Need to stock up on T-shirts? Gildan has you covered with this bestselling multipack, which our editors rave about for its breathable cotton fabric, moisture-wicking finish, and an easy to move in fit. Even though this tee isn’t blended with any spandex or elastane, I was surprised by how easily I could lift my arms and not feel any stiffness or tugging. It didn’t feel like I was wearing a cardboard box. I especially appreciate the classic crew neckline that sits around the neck and doesn’t stretch out after a few wears like most budget packs tend to do.

I typically don’t wear this as a workout tee, but it makes for an excellent undershirt beneath my zip-up hoodies and sweaters. And when I layered it, the tee conforms to my body and stays put. Unlike stretchy shirts that can ride up or bunch, this one stays flat. It’s so soft, thin (but not see-through), and holds shape remarkably well, even after multiple wash cycles.

Now let’s talk shrinkage: I ran it through a normal cold wash and tumble dried on a low heat. It did shrink a bit: about a half inch in length and slightly in the sleeves. But honestly, that ended up making the fit better for me. It hugged around my pecs, molded closer to the torso, and the sleeves hit a more flattering midpoint on my upper arm to show my muscle gains. Plus, it doesn’t pill as swiftly as one would imagine, based on the price.

Read more: Gildan Crew Neck T-Shirt Review.

Recent findings suggest that vuori, one of our favorite athleisure brands, uses moisture-wicking tech fabric in its signature crewneck tee, providing unparalleled comfort while you're running a 5K or just running errands. Unlike with other standard athletic shirts that always fit too tight, I didn't have to go through that trouble myself with this slim fit take, making it a tee I'd actually wear out on its own, because outside is where it shines: To me, its stretch and moisture-wicking have made it look and smell fresh time after time. More importantly, I couldn’t believe how soft it felt when I put it on the first time. It was like being clothed in a cloud, and the breathable fabric was able to keep me cool instead of suffocating me.

Read More: Vuori Strato Tech Tee Review.

In a recent development, anyone who’s owned merino wool knows the entry price is worth the investment. The fabric is famously breathable, and its natural anti-odor properties and moisture-wicking ability make it so you can wear the garment for longer than you'd expect before it gets, well, gross. To test out its merino wool performance, I’ve in fact packed this tee for a recent trip and worn it to hike, walk, and commute for a few days. At the end of the day, when I did take it off, I was delighted to find out that it remained as fresh as when I first put it on, after all those hours of traveling in it.

Recent findings suggest that winner of our Fitness Awards’ best short sleeve tee, Rhone’s Reign is perhaps the most comfortable workout T-shirt the athletic guys at Men's Health have ever tested and worn to a gym session. "This breathable top moves with you when you reach overhead for pull-ups and chin-ups thanks to its seamless construction," says our fitness director Ebenezer Samuel, C.S.C.S..

Industry observers note that in addition, its breathable, moisture-wicking fabric has always come in a pinch for me whenever the gym gets a bit too heated. No matter how intense our sessions can be, I still feel and smell fresh after sweating bullets, thanks to the anti-odor technology.

A couple of years ago, the Los Angeles-based Buck Mason purchased two century-old knitting mills in Eastern Pennsylvania that were on the verge of closure. Now all of the brand’s T-shirts are produced there, from the raw cotton to the finished products. Vertically integrated production like that provides a level of quality control that is evident in the Slub Classic Tee. There were no loose threads or out-of-place stitching, the cut was perfectly balanced, and tremendously sturdy for a relatively lightweight tee.

Our editors love this t-shirt because the weight hits a sweet spot that is surprisingly hard to find. For a while now, most t-shirts have been a little flimsy. Heavyweight cotton tees have made a big comeback recently, but many of these are just a little too bulky. Buck Mason’s slub cotton has a soft feel and loose drape while still feeling sturdy and reliable. The white tee is slightly transparent, but with a speckled texture indicative of slub cotton. It is truly a do-it-all t-shirt that looks good with everything and fits well on most body types.

Recent findings suggest that sunspel is one of those English brands that just gets premium basics. It's been perfecting the art of simple, high-quality clothing since 1860, and its Riviera Midweight T-shirt is proof the makers know exactly what they're doing. Originally created for James Bond (yep, Daniel Craig wore it in Casino Royale), this tee is elevated but effortless, crafted from Supima cotton.

Industry observers note that we're big fans of this material because it's extra-long staple, meaning its fibers are naturally longer than regular cotton, increasing its durability and, ultimately, its lifespan. It's buttery soft yet structured with a tailored-but-not-too-tight fit, making it one of the tees you can dress up or down without a second thought.

During our testing, we found it doesn't pill or wrinkle easily. The slightly shorter length looks better untucked and drapes neatly over your jeans. Plus, it arrives in a whopping 22 colors, so you have every hue to choose from.

Industry observers note that reigning Champ is one of the few clothing brands out there that mills its own fabrics. While the fabric is called mid-weight, it felt sturdier to us than most tees we tried out. The boxy fit was extremely comfortable, with ’90s-inspired sleeves that are on the longer and wider side. This is especially beneficial for guys with broader shoulders and bigger biceps.

It has been revealed that the flatlock seam construction along the sleeves, shoulders, and sides is more commonly seen in sweatshirts, with this being the only T-shirt on the list to feature it. It was a nice touch because flatlock seams reduce friction points, which is especially helpful with a heavier fabric like this one. We noticed the benefit after wearing this tee all day, especially along the shoulder.

Read More: Best White T-Shirts for Men.

Cos offers a ribbed T-shirt that looks and feels much more elevated than your average basic tee. It’s crafted from an organic and recycled cotton-blend jersey that has plenty of stretch and flex, but still substantial in hand. The 230gsm (grams per square meter) fabric gives it a weighty, premium feel without making it stiff or heavy to wear all day. Like the Uniqlo tee, this neckline has a reinforced binding that keeps the neckline from drooping over time. The ribbed texture also adds visual interest, so it feels more styled up than a standard flat cotton top.

The slim fit sits close through the chest and arms, in a flattering way, especially if you’ve got an athletic build. If you’re broader or super jacked, though, you’ll probably want to size up for a little extra room. I usually wear mine tucked in trousers with loafers for dinner or a night out, but it also layers really well under a blazer or lightweight jacket. I toss this tee in the wash and let it air dry to help preserve the shape and texture.

It has been revealed that some necklines on T-shirts tend to droop or stretch after a few wears or washes, but the binding at Uniqlo’s collar helps this one keep its shape. The neckline design is inspired by military vintage tees, which gives it a rugged edge while still looking polished enough to wear on its own. I’ve worn mine at least four times and put it through five wash cycles, and it looks exactly the same as the day I bought it. Not to mention, it’s super affordable, so you’re getting a great cost per wear.

That durability stems from its heavyweight cotton jersey fabric, which feels structured without being overly stiff. It’s thick enough to keep me warm when layered under an open flannel or leather jacket in cooler weather, though I probably might opt for something lighter in high 80s temperatures. Unlike thinner tees, this one has a clean drape that looks good untucked or tucked in trousers or jeans. The fit is not too boxy or too slim, so it works pretty much on every body type with sizes up to 3XL. You grab it in a bunch of easy neutrals for the office, but there are also pops of color like orange or green—the latter being my go-to in the summer.

In a recent development, simply put, this is a quintessential pocket tee available for a very affordable price. It feels like it was pulled from Gap’s ’90s archive, when the brand was known for great-looking basics. The fit was a little boxy, but by no means baggy, and looked flattering on a whole range of body types. Even though the construction details are simple, especially compared to some of the premium tees we tested, it still felt sturdy and reliable.

It has been revealed that the weight of this tee came as a surprise, given the look and price. It felt more like a midweight cotton that held its shape better than most "basic" T-shirts we’ve tried in the past.

Everlane has a talent for making high-quality, affordable basics that can fit seamlessly into pretty much any wardrobe. The Essential Organic Crew is a perfect example of the brand’s mastery of fit, fabric, and colors that have mass appeal while still looking cool. Boxy shoulders, wider sleeves, and a collar that sat just right provided a relaxed feel in our testing, which was perfect for lounging around and casual everyday wear. We wanted to highlight the fabric, not only because it's a sturdy pure cotton jersey, but it comes with a unique washed finish. The T-shirt had a cozy lived-in feel that usually requires quite a few washes and wears to achieve. According to Everlane, this also helps prevent shrinkage, which was not a problem for us after a couple of cold water washes.

According to recent reports, everlane's slim-fit T-shirt nails the perfect balance between tailored and relaxed. It's slim but not clingy, with enough room to let a little breeze pass through the chest and arm area. In other words, you get a shirt that is tailored and polished, but still doesn’t skimp on comfort. The fabric is really where it shines, though.

Recent findings suggest that it’s a premium-weight tee, meaning the material is dense and built to last. It drapes perfectly over the chest, holds shape through countless washes, and gives you that solid, substantial feel. We found it's become softer and softer, the more you wear it. Over time, this shirt doesn't get dingy or pill like the ones you get from fast-fashion brands. I found that it has held its shape well after using it for the past year. Plus, it comes in a number of neutral colors that make it easy to wear on repeat with any jeans or chinos.

Each fit brings its own flavor to the table, so whether you’re going for a sleek, body-conscious look or maximum comfort on a lazy day, there’s a T-shirt out there that’s up your alley. Here, we break down the most common cuts to consider.

This tee is tailored to follow your body’s lines without feeling snug. Go for this if you want your tee to show off your hard-earned gains.

Classic fit tees offer a balanced cut that isn’t too tight or too loose. They drape nicely over any frame, delivering a no-fuss, everyday look that looks great under a blazer, bomber jacket, or on its own on casual Fridays. It’s a reliable go-to when you want to keep your fit simple yet sharp.

When comfort is your mantra, a relaxed fit is where it’s at. These tees give you plenty of room to breathe and move.

In a recent development, built for the guy with a muscular build, athletic fit tees have broader shoulders and a narrower waist. They’re engineered to give your jacked upper body the space it needs without turning you into a walking grocery bag.

It has been revealed that 100% cotton tees are often the gold standard for everyday tees, but cotton often doesn’t perform the best, which is why tech-blended fabrics can give useful features like moisture-wicking, four-way stretch, and breathability. Hence, if you're an active guy, or maybe you sweat a lot naturally, or are looking for tees for going out, ditch the full cotton and opt for blended fabrics. Below is an overview of the kinds of materials to choose from.

The classic choice. Think: breathable, soft, and natural cotton. Whether it's combed, ring-spun, or Pima, pure cotton tees just get better with each wash.

All the comfort of regular cotton, but grown without harsh chemicals. It's eco-friendly and feels extra gentle on your skin.

When cotton teams up with polyester or rayon, you get a tee that's more durable, resists shrinkage, and sometimes even wrinkles less. It's all about that low-maintenance vibe.

Industry observers note that these are designed for action. Performance blends often feature polyester or moisture-wicking fibers to keep you cool and dry. Whether you're hitting the gym or commuting, these tees move with you and manage sweat like a champ.

Different styles of tees work best for different occasions. For instance, a V-neck T-shirt works best as an undershirt and can make your neck look longer. A crewneck is your everyday kind of tee that’s great for layering or on its own. Garment-dyed tees look lived-in for a vintage style. And if you want to look dressy in T-shirts, ditch the plain-looking ones that look like undershirts and go for a pocketed tee instead. Better yet, opt for graphic tees to really make a style statement that is true to you.

To find the best t-shirts for men, our style team led by Style and Reviews Director, Christian Gollayan has personally tried on over 60 different options since 2020 and tested each of them for at least two weeks by wearing them in all sorts of situations. We vetted our tested options by making notes of their style, type, comfort, fit, price point, durability, versatility, and performance such as stretch, moisture-wicking, and breathability.

We examined whether they fit well and true to size, whether their fabric could withstand hours of movement in different temperatures, how the collar stood up after multiple wears, and whether they could be worn for more than one occasion. We also tested these T-shirts on different body types, from slim to athletic to buff, to ensure the most unbiased results.

Specifically, we're looking for T-shirt styles that are not trendy or trend-chasing (so no funky graphics, baggy fits, or holes here); instead, our picks for the best t-shirts for men all fit great even on buff guys, provide a ton of value at reasonable price points, and come in styles that will look great years from now. Keep reading to see which brands earned a spot.

Pair a classic crew-neck or V-neck T-shirt with jeans or chinos (including their shorts variations) for a laid-back vibe. Layer under a denim or bomber jacket for a touch of coolness during cooler weather. Complete the outfit with sneakers or casual shoes like slip-ons.

Sources indicate that opt for lightweight, breathable T-shirts. Style them with shorts or casual linen pants for a cool and relaxed look. Slip into comfortable sandals or boat shoes for added comfort.

Pair a relaxed-fit or classic-fit tee with casual joggers or sweatpants for a totally easy vibe.

Sources indicate that style a light and breezy T-shirt with swim trunks or linen shorts for a beach-ready look. Wear flip-flops or sandals to complement the vacation vibe.

Pick moisture-wicking or performance T-shirts first, and wear them with gym shorts or athletic shorts or track pants for maximum comfort and flexibility during your activities.

If you know the dress code allows, pick a well-fitted (usually slim) T-shirt in a solid color and minimal design (no pocket, for instance). Pair it with tailored trousers or chinos for a more polished appearance (make sure to tuck it), then layer it under a blazer. Complete the look with dress sneakers or leather sneakers.

Recent findings suggest that the most popular and reputable T-shirt brands for men that consistently deliver high-quality tees often happen to be the best clothing brands for men. For instance, Calvin Klein, J.Crew, and Sunspel often churn out classic tees in premium materials suitable for both casual and smart-casual occasions. Buck Mason and Billy Reid are known for making casual pocketed tees with a lived-in vibe and garment-dyed fabric.

Athleisure brands like Vuori, Lululemon, and Rhone make t-shirts that are versatile for all kinds of physical activities. Trendy brands like CDLP, Everlane, and Richer Poorer are what you should go to for relaxed-fit, oversized tees. For undershirts or tees for homebodies, Tommy John, Jockey, Calvin Klein, and Hanes have you covered.

Our all-time favorite, tried-and-tested t-shirt brand, however, is Mack Weldon, which makes tees that are soft, versatile, long-lasting, well-fitted, and can do no wrong.

Recent findings suggest that that depends on the occasion and personal style. For a casual look, you can't go wrong with a classic crew neck T-shirt (especially those that have gone through the wash to look more vintage and lived-in). V-necks add a touch of flair and work great as undershirts. Graphic tees let you showcase your personality, while T-shirts with a pocket let you look a bit more sophisticated. For athletic activities, moisture-wicking and performance t-shirts are a no-brainer when you go to the gym or hike.

Providing the right care to your tees will help keep them looking sharp and feeling comfy for eons. First up, read the damn label! Make sure you follow the washing instructions. Also, be sure to separate colors when you wash T-shirts (i.e. darks with darks and lights with lights).

When you wash, make sure the water is cold because the temperature will help preserve colors and prevent shrinkage. Turning T-shirts inside out can also help protect the outer fabric from friction and fading. Use a gentle cycle and mild detergent to help maintain the shape and fabric, too.

It has been revealed that additionally, skip the dryer and air-dry if possible because high heat can cause shrinkage (use low-heat settings if you must air-dry). We also recommend folding instead of hanging T-shirts because the latter will stretch out the neck of the tees and cause them to lose their shape.

These are two indicators of whether your T-shirt can or should be tucked in or left untucked. With a curved hem, then the tee is best left untucked; it'll probably look better that way. A straight hem can do both, depending on the length. That is to say, a longer length is thus best left tucked in, unless you've got the height or the style magic to offset any disproportion.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, for enthusiasts, tire shopping is an upgrade, not a chore. While the casual driver might treat new tires like regular maintenance, anyone who cares about vehicle dynamics knows that what meets the road defines how a truck or SUV rides, tracks, and stops. It is the single most transformative upgrade you can make to your vehicle. For more than 110 years, Cooper tires have catered to drivers who look past the showroom floor and seek out products that overdeliver on performance, capability, and long-term durability.

And that level of purpose-built engineering is more vital than ever. As vehicles grow heavier and more capable, tires need to do more than simply roll down an interstate. They have to withstand heavy payload demands, sudden weather changes, and unpredictable pavement. Cooper tires are built to that benchmark. Rooted in American engineering and real-world development, Cooper tires are built to an uncompromising standard that live up to their promises. From the rock-crawling STT Pro to the severe-snow-designated Stronghold AT, the Discoverer® family has earned its reputation through real-world testing from Alaskan ice to jagged mountain trails.

Industry observers note that the new Cooper Discoverer® HT adapts that rugged all-terrain lineage for long-distance highway cruising, matching heavy-duty capability with quiet, refined composure. While it retains the structural durability to wander down a gravel trail with a trailer in tow, its core mission is maximizing comfort and control across hundreds of miles of open road.

Where many highway tires trade load capability for a soft ride, the Discoverer® HT is engineered to handle both. Straight, reinforced sidewalls provide the structural foundation needed to maintain an optimal contact patch under load. Whether the vehicle is running light or carrying family, gear, and tongue weight, the tire resists deformation, ensuring consistent steering response and predictable roadholding grip in any condition. It’s engineered for drivers whose tires have to hold their own—providing a dependable, hard-working partner that won’t fold when the truck or SUV is pushed to its limit.

Cooper tires also tackle truck and SUV tire performance, with advanced features. Its proprietary 3-D Micro-Gauge Siping incorporates interlocking zig-zag sipes inside the tread blocks. Under heavy braking, sharp turns, or loaded acceleration, these interlocking sipes lock together to stiffen the tread block, to help support responsiveness. Crucially, these sipes run deep into the tread rubber, ensuring that gripping edges are still present to help with traction. That structural integrity backs up an exceptional UTQG treadwear rating of 720 and a 70,000-mile limited treadwear warranty on passenger fitments.

This is the tire for drivers who expect their trucks or suvs to show up for the long haul. Whether that means towing a camper into the backcountry, handling moving-day payloads, or eating up cross-country interstate miles in quiet comfort, the mission remains the same: a single set of tires that balances real-world traction, refined manners, and hard-working capability.

To fit that wide spectrum of work, Cooper offers the Discoverer® HT across 19 passenger sizes covering 16- to 22-inch wheels (with section widths from 245 to 285 mm), alongside 16 light-truck (LT) options engineered with deeper tread grooves and higher load ratings. Backed by a 45-day satisfaction guarantee and over a century of research and development, the Discoverer® HT delivers what Cooper has always stood for: the quiet confidence that the job was done right.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • “Three other species in this genus are still waiting in line,” Arthur Tiutenko, a study co-author and herpetologist at Germany’s Friedrich-Alexander University of Erlangen–Nuremberg (FAU), said in a statement.
  • Industry observers note that many snakes will snack on an egg if the opportunity presents itself.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that biologists have discovered multiple latest species of egg-eating snakes slithering through the forests near southeastern Ethiopia’s Bale Mountains. Although researchers only described the white-throated egg-eater (Dasypeltis albigularis) in their study recently published in the journal Herpetozoa, they promised that information on additional finds is on the way.

“Three other species in this genus are still waiting in line,” Arthur Tiutenko, a study co-author and herpetologist at Germany’s Friedrich-Alexander University of Erlangen–Nuremberg (FAU), said in a statement.

Industry observers note that many snakes will snack on an egg if the opportunity presents itself. But for a handful of species, it’s all eggs, all the time. These nonvenomous snakes solely eat shelled embryos, and largely exist in Africa and some portions of India. To devour their meals, egg-eating snakes have evolved a set of very clever biological tricks. First, their back bones extend all the way into their esophagus and function like a saw to slice open shells. From there, the snake’s neck muscles contract and funnel the egg contents down its throat. Once finished, the reptile simply spits out the cracked shells.

However, Tiutenko’s team almost missed D. albigularis entirely. At first glance, the snake looks extremely similar to a species called the montane egg-eater (Dasypeltis atra). A closer inspection revealed some key differences—a patch of white scales extending down its stomach earned its “white-throated” moniker, while the skin between each scale has a distinctly blue shimmer. Other egg-eating snakes can rub their scales to create a rustling noise that startles foes, but only the D. albigularis females do the same—and they do it silently.

Don’t envision python-sized snakes chowing down on chicken eggs though. D. albigularis is less than eight inches long, weighs only 0.05 ounces, and is about as thick as a knitting needle. This means the snakes only have eyes for particularly tiny eggs from various diminutive birds. Luckily, their regional home is full of options.

“That may also be the reason why egg-eating snakes only live in Africa, and in particular in a small area in the southwest corner of the Arabian peninsula,” added Tiutenko.

  • Although several major foodborne illness outbreaks have ended and their associated recalls are no longer active, food safety remains an important concern.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Following a series of high-profile food recalls and outbreaks this year, many Americans may be concerned about keeping their families safe from foodborne illness during the holidays.

According to recent reports, in fact, according to a recent national survey by Orlando Health, around 60% of U.S. adults say they’re more concerned about foodborne illness this year than in previous years.

Although several major foodborne illness outbreaks have ended and their associated recalls are no longer active, food safety remains an important concern. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) estimates that 48 million people in the United States experience foodborne illness each year.

However, there are simple steps you can take to reduce the risk of foodborne illness when preparing holiday meals and storing leftovers.

While there were several food recalls in the United States over the summer, two of the largest involved Salmonella linked to jalapeños and Cyclospora linked to lettuce.

These outbreaks prompted widespread recalls and raised concerns about the safety of certain foods, particularly fresh produce.

Although health officials have since declared the major outbreaks over, some consumers may still be hesitant to purchase foods associated with previous recalls.

Even with this declaration, you may still feel nervous about purchasing certain foods, but experts say you don’t need to worry.

According to recent reports, “Here in the United States, we have the safest food supply in the world. The recent recalls show that our food safety system is working,” noted William Schaffner, MD, Professor, Division of Infectious Diseases at Vanderbilt University.

It has been revealed that michelle Routhenstein, preventive cardiology dietitian at Entirely Nourished, told Healthline that past recalls do not mean entire food categories need to be avoided. The important thing is whether the specific product you have matches a current recall, based on details such as brand, lot number, package size, and expiration date.

“You should enjoy familiar foods, including properly cooked poultry, washed fruits and vegetables, and pasteurized dairy products,” she remarked. “The key is checking relevant recalls and practicing safe food handling.”.

“Before shopping or cooking, review FDA and USDA (U.S. Department of Agriculture) recall information and compare any relevant notices with the labels on your ingredients,” remarked Routhenstein.

Check the pantry and freezer, too: something purchased months ago may still be affected.

Industry observers note that “Stay alert to any news reports about food recalls and use good food preparation practices. Those simple actions should keep your holidays happy and safe,” remarked Schaffner.

Schaffner emphasized the importance of following safe food-handling practices when preparing everyday meals and holiday gatherings.

“Remember the longstanding advice: keep food hot or cold. Avoid long times at room temperature,” he remarked.

Routhenstein advised focusing on four basics: clean, separate, cook, and chill.

Schaffner noted the importance of refrigerating leftovers promptly rather than leaving them at room temperature for extended periods. He recommends clearing the table and refrigerating leftovers soon after the meal ends.

Routhenstein reiterated that you should refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours rather than leaving them out to cool.

Divide turkey into smaller portions and transfer sides and gravy into shallow containers to help them cool promptly, she advised.

Leftovers can typically be stored in the refrigerator for 3–4 days. If you don’t proposal to eat them within that time, consider freezing them.

The crucial thing is to keep an eye out for any newly introduced recalls, practice food safety, and enjoy your holiday meals!

Why Kissing Matters More Than You Think During Sex

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (962 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Psychologytoday

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Posted November 23, 2026 | Reviewed by Ekua Hagan.
  • In today’s sexual landscape, we are getting a lot of information about how to supercharge our sex lives.
  • Industry observers note that researcher Lisa Wade (2017) found that in hook-up culture, people tend to follow the “no kissing during sex” rule to preserve boundaries, ostensibly keeping sex casual and emotionally safe.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Posted November 23, 2026 | Reviewed by Ekua Hagan.

In today’s sexual landscape, we are getting a lot of information about how to supercharge our sex lives. There are Instagram ads for vibrators and other accessories, shelves of toys at our local drugstore, and no end of supplements marketed to anyone whose libido might be waning. But the data tells us that actually our strongest—but most undervalued—predictor of satisfying sex is just good old-fashioned kissing. And this is as true for people hooking up with new partners as it is for those in long-term relationships.

So why has kissing fallen out of fashion?

Industry observers note that researcher Lisa Wade (2017) found that in hook-up culture, people tend to follow the “no kissing during sex” rule to preserve boundaries, ostensibly keeping sex casual and emotionally safe. But that strategy for avoiding feeling too close to a casual partner can have an unintended consequence. Eschewing kissing can, as my own students report, leave them feeling empty afterward. For long-term partners, kissing can be bypassed out of time constraints and a misguided attempt at sexual efficiency. When you are trying to squeeze sex in around busy jobs or parenting, it can be tempting to “jump to the main event.” Meanwhile, both groups can be influenced by porn that emphasizes novel activities like choking over “vanilla” activities like kissing. But the research indicates that forgoing kissing to keep sex casual or efficient skips the activity that most reliably predicts it being good, and it’s women who pay the price.

When researchers Busby et al. (2021) set out to quantify the impact of kissing on relationship and sexual satisfaction in long-term relationships, they found that both specific kissing (during the most recent sexual experience) and global kissing (during the last year) were positively associated with their subjects’ perspective on the quality of their sex lives and their overall relationship satisfaction. For women, kissing during sex was positively associated with their ability to orgasm, sexual frequency, and indirectly with sexual satisfaction. Because they were more likely to orgasm, this positive reinforcement made them want to have sex more often, creating a virtuous feedback loop. These findings suggest that kissing shouldn’t be thought of as superfluous, but rather reclassified as foundational to relationship maintenance and a couple’s sexual repertoire.

While both sexes associate more kissing with a stronger relationship, the orgasm benefits definitely skew toward women. Kissing signals emotional closeness, slows the pace of the encounter, and extends foreplay, all of which raise arousal and make orgasm more likely for women.

Recent findings suggest that this is why Wade’s research into hooking up with an understanding that kissing is off the table sets women at a disadvantage. When researcher Frederick and his team (2017) asked a cross-sample of people if their last sexual encounter led to orgasm, unsurprisingly, 65 percent of heterosexual women answered affirmatively compared to 95 percent of heterosexual men. This is called the orgasm gap. Kissing can help close that gap even for newly introduced partners.

In addition to incorporating specific kissing back into sex, pay attention to global kissing. The above studies are correlational, but this study isn’t: Kory Floyd and colleagues (2009) assigned married and cohabiting couples to kiss more for six weeks. Compared with controls, the kissing group had lower stress, lower cholesterol, and higher relationship satisfaction. In a classic “fake it till you make it” framework, starting with increasing kissing can lead to a stronger relationship, rather than waiting for events to unfold the other way around.

Sources indicate that new research from Christopher Watkins and Milena Rota (2026) found that fantasy and sexual imagination inform the perception of a good kiss rather than technique. And even more key than technique is duration. The Gottmans claim that as long as a kiss lasts at least six seconds, the brain releases oxytocin, which is the bonding hormone that enables all of the above (Brittle, 2014).

According to recent reports, so, in our overscheduled, overstimulating world, think about coming back to basics. If your sex life has gone flat, kissing is the easiest place to start because it’s free, you can’t run out, its batteries won’t go dead, and best of all, it brings both people into the moment. That's what great sex is all about.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Resilience and perseverance was on full display in Alaska this summer. The park rangers at Tongass National Forest in the southeastern corner of the state spotted an unnamed black bear (Ursus americanus) with a broken arm. Even with this injury, the tough bear still managed to catch the fish running through Anan Creek. For this grit, the rangers awarded the bear with the 2026 Grin & Bear It Award.

“We don’t know how the injury happened, but we’re impressed by the bear’s resilience,” the rangers write. “In other wild places the injury may have been a death sentence, but the abundance of Anan gives this bear a chance.”.

Tongass National Forest’s rangers are awarding the annual Anan Bear Awards to the 39 bears spotted at the Anan Wildlife Observatory in Alaska over the summer.

Sources indicate that the largest national forest in the United States, Tongass covers most of southeastern Alaska, including the state’s capital city of Juneau. The area also includes Mendenhall Glacier (a popular destination for Alaskan cruises), hiking trails, eagles soaring above, and plenty of bears. One of the hotspots is Anan Creek, home to one of the largest runs of pink salmon in Southeast Alaska. As such, the creek is a very popular dinner spot among black and brown bears.

Industry observers note that according to Friends of Anan, 39 bears are known to feast on the salmon at Anan Creek. The population includes 31 black bears like the one with the broken arm and eight brown bears (Ursus arctos). Similar to their portly counterparts farther to the north in Katmai National Park, the bears return each summer to feast on salmon and teach their cubs how to fish in order to survive. And also like the fat bears of Katmai, every bear here has their own behaviors and quirks.

The U.S. Forest Service tracks and documents every bear spotted at Anan, while explore.org’s cameras broadcast live streams of their behavior.

Breaking: Planning to Stop Taking a GLP-1? Here’s How to Maintain Weight Loss

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Switching GLP-1 medications or undergoing bariatric surgery may help people maintain greater weight loss than stopping treatment entirely, according to a fresh study presented at ObesityWeek and published in eClinicalMedicine on November 14.
  • The Cleveland Clinic study compared five strategies for managing weight after treatment with GLP-1 medications, analyzing data from 20,486 adults with obesity or type 2 diabetes.
  • In a recent development, people who stop taking GLP-1 medications often regain weight.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Switching GLP-1 medications or undergoing bariatric surgery may help people maintain greater weight loss than stopping treatment entirely, according to a fresh study presented at ObesityWeek and published in eClinicalMedicine on November 14.

The Cleveland Clinic study compared five strategies for managing weight after treatment with GLP-1 medications, analyzing data from 20,486 adults with obesity or type 2 diabetes.

In a recent development, people who stop taking GLP-1 medications often regain weight. Researchers examined whether continuing treatment, switching medications, or undergoing bariatric surgery could help limit weight regain or support further weight loss.

The findings showed that people who underwent bariatric surgery or switched between semaglutide (Ozempic) and tirzepatide (Zepbound) experienced the greatest overall weight loss.

According to recent reports, the study participants had an average age of 56.7 years, an average weight of 109 kg (240.3 lbs), and an average body mass index (BMI) of 38. All had been taking either semaglutide or tirzepatide for at least 90 days.

The researchers categorized the participants into five groups:.

After 2 years, those who underwent bariatric surgery saw an average loss of 28.2% of their body weight or about 31.5 kg (69.4 lbs).

“We increasingly view medications and surgery as complementary tools rather than competing ones,” stated Mir Ali, MD, medical director of MemorialCare Surgical Weight Loss Center at Orange Coast Medical Center in Fountain Valley, CA, who wasn’t involved in the study.

In a recent development, “For patients with severe obesity (typically a BMI of 35 or higher, or 30+ with metabolic conditions like type 2 diabetes), bariatric surgery remains the most durable, cost-effective intervention available,” he added. “Using a GLP-1 beforehand can safely reduce liver volume and lower surgical risk, while surgery provides the permanent anatomical and hormonal reset needed to maintain that weight loss long-term without relying indefinitely on weekly injections.”.

During the same period, those who switched between semaglutide and tirzepatide lost 16% of their body weight, or about 18 kg (39.6 lbs).

Recent findings suggest that participants who switched from semaglutide to tirzepatide lost 3 kg (6.6 lbs) more than those who continued taking semaglutide. However, participants already taking tirzepatide lost 4.5 kg (9.9 lbs) more by continuing treatment rather than switching to semaglutide.

The other groups experienced lower amounts of weight loss:.

After one year, participants with type 2 diabetes experienced HbA1c reductions of 1.76% following bariatric surgery, 1.43% after switching GLP-1 medications, and 1.32% after continuing their original medication, compared with 0.48% among those who discontinued treatment entirely.

After one year, participants with hypertension (high blood pressure) also experienced greater reductions in blood pressure following surgery or switching GLP-1 medications than those who discontinued treatment entirely.

“[This study] reinforces the need for a long term, multi-modal continuum of care rather than treating GLP-1s as a temporary fix,” said Ali.

Ali also recommended the following strategies to help maintain weight loss after stopping a GLP-1 medication:.

The findings highlight the importance of having a long-term weight management plan in place before stopping a GLP-1 medication.

Before stopping a GLP-1 medication, talk with a healthcare professional. They can help you explore your options and determine which strategies may be most appropriate for your health needs.

Ali told Healthline that identifying the reason for stopping treatment is an important first step. He noted that people often discontinue GLP-1 medications because of gastrointestinal side effects, supply challenges, or loss of insurance coverage rather than because they no longer need treatment.

He said that if side effects are the problem, adjusting the dose or switching to a different agent often solves the problem.

Ali also emphasized that stopping a GLP-1 medication shouldn’t be viewed as a test of willpower. Increased hunger after discontinuing treatment is a biological response, not a personal failure.

“Have a concrete ‘off-ramp’ blueprint in place with your doctor before taking your last dose, so you have medical, nutritional, or surgical support ready to protect the health gains you worked hard to achieve,” advised Ali.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • The conversion of the automotive industry over to electric vehicles, sold as a foregone conclusion by many car brands in the early 2020s, may have largely stalled out in America, but the picture is far different globally.
  • Industry observers note that and the global increase came despite falling sales in China.
  • In a recent development, meanwhile, electric vehicle sales have declined in the United States this year.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

The conversion of the automotive industry over to electric vehicles, sold as a foregone conclusion by many car brands in the early 2020s, may have largely stalled out in America, but the picture is far different globally. According to data from the Commonwealth Bank of Australia, EVs now account for 31 percent of all passenger vehicle sales.

Industry observers note that and the global increase came despite falling sales in China. The major driver of electric vehicle sales has been Europe; European EV sales have risen 37 percent year over year so far in 2026, climbing to 43 percent of the new vehicle sales market. CommBank data also indicated substantial growth rates in countries such as Brazil (EV sales up 164 percent, to a 13 percent market share) and India (EV sales up 76 percent, to a 9 percent market share). Even in Japan, where manufacturers have been notably EV-reticent, sales jumped 80 percent year-over-year to 5 percent of the market.

In a recent development, meanwhile, electric vehicle sales have declined in the United States this year. According to Cox Automotive data, EV sales made up 6.4 percent of the latest car market in Q3 of 2026, down from more than 10 percent in Q3 of 2025. Fuel prices have been elevated this year, but that has led Americans to gravitate toward hybrids rather than fully electric vehicles. Total electrified vehicles now account for nearly 25 percent of the American market.

Sources indicate that much of the decline has been a direct result of Trump administration policies. Last year, the U.S. eliminated a $7500 federal tax credit for electric cars, which—due to a commercial vehicle loophole—made them especially cheap for buyers to lease; the 10 percent share of sales in Q3 2025 came from a glut of sales as buyers rushed to take advantage of the tax credits before they expired. Congress is also considering imposing an annual federal tax on electric cars.

Sources indicate that the Trump administration has also effectively eliminated enforcement of America’s CAFE standards, which would have effectively forced manufacturers to sell EVs to avoid hefty fines. American laws and tariffs also effectively prohibit importing affordable Chinese-made EVs, which have been a major reason behind the sales increase in Europe.

This 500 kWh energy storage system runs on retired EV batteries

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • A retired EV battery can still have years of use left in it when it’s taken off the road.
  • Nova was unveiled at RE+ in Las Vegas this week, and it’s already in production at Megafactory 1, the battery-repurposing plant that Moment Energy opened in the Vancouver area in June.
  • Each Nova unit delivers 500 kilowatt-hours (kWh) of energy and 200 kilowatts (kW) of power.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

A retired EV battery can still have years of use left in it when it’s taken off the road. Moment Energy’s new Nova battery storage system puts those packs to work on commercial sites. And when a pack wears out, it can be swapped without pulling out the whole system.

Nova was unveiled at RE+ in Las Vegas this week, and it’s already in production at Megafactory 1, the battery-repurposing plant that Moment Energy opened in the Vancouver area in June.

Each Nova unit delivers 500 kilowatt-hours (kWh) of energy and 200 kilowatts (kW) of power. It has a 2.94 m by 1.80 m (9.7 x 5.9 ft) footprint, and units can be linked together for projects in the tens of megawatt-hours. A site could charge the batteries when electricity is cheaper or when its solar panels are producing more than it needs, then draw on that power when demand spikes or the grid goes down.

Industry observers note that nova can use packs from different EV models, even when those packs have aged at different rates. Moment’s battery management software tracks how each pack is doing. As packs wear out, the organization can replace them while leaving the enclosure and concrete pad in place. Moment indicates its pack replacement service could keep a system in service for more than 20 years.

In a recent development, “We see a future where reengineered EV batteries become essential infrastructure for powering businesses and onshoring manufacturing and supply chains. Nova brings that vision to life, combining safety, engineering, and North American manufacturing to deploy the safest and highest-performance batteries ever made: EV batteries to supercharge our aging grid,” said Edward Chiang, co-founder and CEO of Moment Energy.

It has been revealed that moment Energy states Nova is the first storage system built from retired EV batteries to earn both UL 1973 certification for the batteries and UL 9540 certification for the complete system. It was also tested under UL 9540A, which looks at how a battery fire can spread. The factory itself is certified under UL 1974, which covers how used batteries are assessed and graded for reuse.

That matters for businesses with limited space. Nova is designed to sit outdoors alongside the buildings it serves. It uses liquid cooling, detects smoke, heat, and flammable gases, and is rated to operate from −13F to 122F (−25C to 50C).

Moment Energy also claims an independent review found that Nova meets US federal sourcing restrictions tied to the clean electricity investment tax credit. Those rules are one part of determining whether a project qualifies for the credit.

Orders are open, and Moment Energy expects the first units to ship in Q1 2027 for deployments across North America.

General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Popsci ↗ Open Full Page

Psychedelic therapies may improve decision making

📅 20 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (556 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Popsci

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Psychedelics such as ketamine and psilocybin continue to show promise as alternative treatments for mental health challenges like anxiety and depression.
  • According to recent reports, the team’s experiment was straightforward.
  • While the untreated rodents performed moderately well, they often made mistakes like returning to a specific location no matter the light cue.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Psychedelics such as ketamine and psilocybin continue to show promise as alternative treatments for mental health challenges like anxiety and depression. Although they’re commonly associated with mind-altering trips and sometimes confounding experiences, recent research indicates small doses may provide an opposite outcome. In a study published today in the journal Science Advances, researchers show that psychedelics may actually improve decision making in certain situations.

According to recent reports, the team’s experiment was straightforward. After supplying lab mice with small amounts of ketamine or psilocybin, neuroscientists exposed them to a simple, sensory-based training exercise. Each mouse was tasked with identifying which of two sites contained a reward based on light pulses emitted from either location. Researchers then compared their decisions with a control group of mice who didn’t receive either psychedelic.

While the untreated rodents performed moderately well, they often made mistakes like returning to a specific location no matter the light cue. However, the mice treated with ketamine or psilocybin appeared to rely less on repetition and more on sensory observations. As a result, they had fewer errors and found the location more effectively.

“These findings reveal how psychedelics reduce the reliance on habits and repetitive choices, which may explain part of their therapeutic effect,” Benjamin Scott, a Boston University psychologist and study co-author, said in a statement.

In a recent development, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) have remained the most commonly prescribed anxiety and depression medications for decades, but they often come with caveats. Patients usually take SSRIs for weeks before experiencing any relief, and they must take them consistently for indefinite periods of time. Meanwhile, about 30 percent of people with depression are resistant to SSRIs, which makes treatment much more difficult. Another benefit is that the effects of ketamine and psilocybin are much easier to map in the brain compared to SSRIs, even after a half century of research.

“We know a great deal about how psychedelics affect the nervous system,” said Scott.

On a molecular level, psychedelics bind to receptors on neurons, protective neural cells called glia, and likely other cells. Once attached, the effects compound throughout the brain by altering cellular activity, circuits, and neuroactivity. Psilocybin works with serotonin receptors to influence how information is processed. In contrast, ketamine is a dissociative psychedelic that functions as an antagonist to specific receptors.

“The discovery we report in this paper is that these two drugs have similar pro-cognitive effects, at least in mice performing a simple task,” Scott explained. “Both drugs strengthen the influence of sensory evidence on choices and reduce the effect of bias.”.

The study’s authors do note some potentially negative effects, as well. Although a mouse’s accuracy improved, the correct decisions sometimes came more slowly than before they took the psychedelics. Scott mentioned this may logically translate to impacts on human reaction times, which could be a problem during activities like driving a car or playing sports. Despite this, the team is still confident in what psychedelics have already accomplished for patients, as well as what that could mean in the future. Scott cited existing evidence of patients reporting noticeable, long-lasting improvements after a single dose of psilocybin.

“This is dramatically different than today’s first-line drugs for depression,” he added.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

BYD is preparing to launch a upcoming flagship MPV soon after previewing the large people mover for the first time.

We knew it was coming soon after images of the camouflaged multi-purpose vehicle (MPV) began flooding the internet last month.

Zhang Zhuo, general manager of BYD’s Ocean sales division, confirmed the new flagship MPV is coming soon.

“A latest creation for the times, born for the family,” Zhuo remarked after posting a preview of it for the first time on his Weibo account on Friday.

Industry observers note that the latest flagship Ocean MPV is “coming soon,” according to Zhuo, but he didn’t reveal a specific debut date. He previously remarked the organization expects to launch its first MPV under the Ocean lineup by the end of 2026, so local reports suggest it will make an official debut next week at the 2026 Guangzhou Auto show, which kicks off on November 27.

Although it’s blurred, the preview indicates a similar shape and size to the recent spy images, with a roof-mounted LiDAR and traditional pull-style door handles.

It doesn’t appear to look much like the futuristic Ocean-V concept BYD unveiled at the 2026 Beijing Auto Show earlier this year, a preview of its first MPV under the Ocean series.

The concept featured a sliding center display screen and two different modes: Camping and Movie. In camping mode, the seats either fold flat to create a bed or swivel to face each other.

In Movie mode, the vehicle transforms into a private mobile theater with a large display screen that flips out of the dashboard.

While it may not have some of the more extravagant elements from the concept, the Ocean MPV is expected to be “flagship-worthy,” if you will, with BYD’s latest tech and other premium features like zero-gravity seats and plenty of digital screens.

The Ocean-V’s innovations “will gradually make their way into mass-production vehicles,” BYD stated earlier this year.

BYD has yet to announce any details, but the flagship Ocean MPV is expected to be about the size of the Xia, a large plug-in hybrid minivan sold under its Dynasty lineup.

The BYD Xia measures 5,145 mm long, 1,970 mm wide, and 1,805 mm tall, with a 3,045 mm wheelbase.

Like the Xia, the Ocean MPV is expected to use BYD’s latest-generation DM-i plug-in hybrid system with a 1.5L engine and a 200 kW electric motor.

Recent findings suggest that the Xia starts at 249,800 yuan ($37,500) in China. It’s available with two BYD Blade LFP battery packs: 20.4 kWh and 36.6 kWh, providing pure electric CLTC ranges of 100 km (62 miles) and 218 km (135 miles). On a full tank of gas and full charge, the plug-in people mover offers a combined CLTC range of 1,163 km (722 miles).

BYD also sells the flagship Denza D9 MPV under its luxury sub-brand. With the Denza D9 starting above 300,000 yuan and the Xia at around 250,000 yuan, the Ocean MPV is expected to fill the gap.

Zhuo said to stay tuned for more coming soon, so check back for updates.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In the classic Thanksgiving comedy Planes, Trains and Automobiles, hapless hero Del Griffith (played by the late, great John Candy) delivers an emotional riposte to Steve Martin’s uptight ad man Neal Page that stands as a beautifully dignified defense of kindness, empathy and self-love in the face of his own perceived shortcomings.

Recent findings suggest that “You want to hurt me? Go right ahead if it makes you feel any better…I could be a cold, hard cynic like you. But I don’t like to hurt people’s feelings. You think what you want about me, I’m not changing. I… I like me. My wife likes me…because I’m the real article. What you see is what you get.”.

According to recent reports, for many of us around the holidays, particularly after a night of excess, Del and Neal’s exchange could read as our internal monologue – your kinder inner voice battling the internal bully who judges your every overindulgence. The jury’s out on whether the kind voice is ever as potent as Del’s is in that moment. But it should be, because when it comes to your health around the holidays, the bully has usually got it wrong.

According to recent reports, the truth is, for most of us, one day of immoderation during Thanksgiving is unlikely to matter in the grand scheme. As such, you would do well to avoid the litany of holiday season health myths out there, many of which seem hell-bent on punishing you for taking a day off:.

Like all misinformation, these kinds of medical myths are loud and tend to die hard, but they almost always trade on quick fixes that target the wrong thing.

According to recent reports, A 2020 review of 23 observational studies found that most showed significant weight gain during festive periods, averaging roughly a pound and a half. One of the original studies, a landmark NIH study from 2000, found that much of that weight tends to stick around. So the question is not what you ate on Thanksgiving Thursday and how swiftly you can “undo the damage,” but rather whether the extended holiday season becomes a two-month period where your healthy routine goes out the window. Some things to look out for on that front:.

None of this is a free pass for everyone. If you manage a health condition, you likely have less margin for error, even when talking about a single meal or a drink. Critical factors include timing, sodium intake, alcohol intake, and missed medication. A few non-exhaustive examples:.

Whatever condition you’re managing, the move for all of them remains the same – be prepared. Check your blueprint with your care team before the holiday, not after, and call them if something feels off afterward.

It has been revealed that technically, feeling good on Black Friday starts on Thursday. A short and light walk after a feast can help smooth out post-meal blood sugar – the earlier the better, ideally within an hour of eating. Staying upright for a couple of hours to help with digestion, particularly if you’re prone to reflux, is also a great idea. If you’re on medication, remember to take it on time. And, at the risk of sounding prudish, and this goes for everyone: try to get to bed at a sensible hour.

Above all else, Thanksgiving is a holiday built around gratitude and kindness, so channel your inner Del Griffith and remember to be both grateful and kind, to yourself and to those around you – evidence suggests that’s also good for your health.

Robin Hough is the Editor-in-Chief of Healthline, and in addition to this regular Letter from the Editor column, he can be found every other Wednesday in our Healthline Wellness Wire newsletter.
